d14HJLgUrMu7aAlZBkLaUA.zh: 歐盟今年7月共計13國報告118例確定病例,以保加利亞(61 例)、義大利(29例)、西班牙(7例)、波蘭(7例)及比利時(4例)為多。近12個月(2025/8/1-2026/7/31)共計30國報告2,339例病例,其中2,012例(86.0%)經實驗室確診。個案集中於15歲(含)以上(51.2%)。ECDC評估疫情主因為部分國家疫苗覆蓋率不足、境外移入等因素,並呼籲各國提升疫苗覆蓋率至95%以上。 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至9/5(第35週),計17個國家/地區累計報告52,676例確定病例及61例死亡(CFR:0.12%),較去年同期病例數增加約3.8倍。有99.5%的病例集中於瓜地馬拉(33,334 例)、墨西哥(12,848例)、美國(3,134例)、秘魯(1,997例)及加拿大(1,119例);泛美衛生組織(PAHO)預計今年11月進行評估墨西哥消除麻疹認證。
d14HJLgUrMu7aAlZBkLaUA.en: In July this year, 13 EU countries reported a total of 118 confirmed cases, mainly Bulgaria (61), Italy (29), Spain (7), Poland (7) and Belgium (4). Over the past 12 months (1 August 2025–31 July 2026), 30 countries reported 2,339 cases, of which 2,012 (86.0%) were laboratory-confirmed. Cases are concentrated among people aged 15 and over (51.2%). The ECDC attributes the outbreaks mainly to insufficient vaccination coverage in some countries and imported cases, and calls on countries to raise vaccination coverage to above 95%. In the Americas, as of 5 September this year (week 35), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 52,676 confirmed cases and 61 deaths (CFR 0.12%), about 3.8 times the number in the same period last year. Some 99.5% of cases were concentrated in Guatemala (33,334), Mexico (12,848), the United States (3,134), Peru (1,997) and Canada (1,119). PAHO plans to assess Mexico's measles elimination certification in November this year.

QkWx_T6ZifDX1nNOfpTTGw.zh: 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至8/22(第33週),計17個國家/地區累計報告51,027例確定病例及55例死亡(CFR:0.10%),較去年同期病例數增加約4.6倍,96%病例來自瓜地馬拉(32,566例)、墨西哥(12,607例)、美國(2,777例)及加拿大(1,117例)。
QkWx_T6ZifDX1nNOfpTTGw.en: Americas regional update: as of 22 August this year (week 33), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 51,027 confirmed cases and 55 deaths (CFR 0.10%), about 4.6 times the number in the same period last year. 96% of cases came from Guatemala (32,566), Mexico (12,607), the United States (2,777) and Canada (1,117).

lffYidjRiGEcjH1J9dxY1g.zh: 南非今年截至8/16(第33週),累計報告3,891例確定病例,較上週增加144例,1-14歲兒童佔總病例數之70%,新增病例以西開普省38例為多,其次為林波波省30例及北開普省20例;疫苗接種覆蓋率不足為主要因素,1歲以下未接種疫苗比例從2017年12.1%上升至2026年36.3%,該國優先針對未接種疫苗或尚未完整接種之兒童進行補接種作業。 秘魯今年截至第33週報告1,747例確定病例,其中以普諾地區(1,264例)為多,由於病例數增加,該國衛生部發佈流行病學警報,針對醫療機構加強流行病學監測及早期發現,並在受影響地區採取防治措施。 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至8/8(第31週),計17個國家/地區累積報告48,690例確定病例及51例死亡(CFR:0.10%),較去年同期病例數增加約4倍,97%病例來自瓜地馬拉(31,140例)、墨西哥(12,479例)、美國(2,465例)及加拿大(1,114例),部分國家通報延遲,研判疫情可能低估。
lffYidjRiGEcjH1J9dxY1g.en: South Africa: as of 16 August this year (week 33), 3,891 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, an increase of 144 over the previous week; children aged 1–14 account for 70% of total cases. The largest numbers of new cases are in Western Cape (38), followed by Limpopo (30) and Northern Cape (20). Insufficient vaccination coverage is the main factor: the proportion of unvaccinated children under 1 year old rose from 12.1% in 2017 to 36.3% in 2026. The country is prioritising catch-up vaccination for unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated children. Peru: as of week 33 this year, 1,747 confirmed cases have been reported, mainly in the Puno region (1,264 cases). Because case numbers are rising, the Ministry of Health has issued an epidemiological alert, strengthening surveillance and early detection in healthcare facilities and taking control measures in affected areas. Americas regional update: as of 8 August this year (week 31), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 48,690 confirmed cases and 51 deaths (CFR 0.10%), about four times the number in the same period last year; 97% of cases came from Guatemala (31,140), Mexico (12,479), the United States (2,465) and Canada (1,114). Because some countries reported with delays, the outbreak is likely underestimated.

9Sy_28kFI749-lWADpjmIw.zh: 加拿大多倫多截至目前報告6例確定病例,於7/2-26期間出現症狀,主要為居住、工作或造訪該區之人員,衛生機構透過環境採樣進行可能感染源調查,並實施預防性防治措施,包含通知醫療機構協助識別可能潛在之病例。
9Sy_28kFI749-lWADpjmIw.en: Toronto, Canada, has reported 6 confirmed cases to date, with symptoms appearing between 2 and 26 July. Most were residents, workers or visitors to the area. Health authorities are conducting environmental sampling to investigate the possible source and have implemented preventive measures, including notifying healthcare facilities to help identify potential cases.

gycHfUG0_SSsbv81_ZxC_g.zh: 加拿大魁北克省報告首例流浪貓感染浣熊狂犬病病例,該省今年截至7/27已確診126例野生動物狂犬病,主要感染動物為浣熊與臭鼬。當局警示,流浪貓可能成為狂犬病病毒由野生動物傳入人類生活環境之橋梁,呼籲飼主務必為寵物完成狂犬病疫苗接種,7/16通報流浪貓抓咬傷⺠眾,致3人接受暴露後預防接種事件。
gycHfUG0_SSsbv81_ZxC_g.en: Quebec Province in Canada has reported the first case of a stray cat infected with raccoon rabies. As of 27 July this year, the province has confirmed 126 wildlife rabies cases, mainly in raccoons and skunks. Authorities warn that stray cats may serve as a bridge for the rabies virus to pass from wildlife into human living environments, and urge pet owners to ensure their pets are fully vaccinated against rabies. On 16 July, a bite or scratch from a stray cat was reported, and 3 people received post-exposure vaccination as a result.

SrZaQQj5mzmfT7JyDIYI0A.zh: 巴布亞紐幾內亞衛生部於今年7/7宣佈爆發疫情,該國8個省份自今年1月以來累計報告108例疑個案(含3例確定病例),由於該國實驗室檢驗量能不足,須送往澳洲進行檢驗,可能低估實際傳播情形。另病例地理分佈無流行病學關聯,且該國疫苗覆蓋率低,預期疫情擴散。 巴西今年截至7/31,累計報告18例確定病例,主要集中於首都聖保羅(15例)之2歲以下與20-50歲族群。此波疫情為該國獲得消除麻疹認證後,首次出現持續性本土傳播,主因為該地區為重要樞紐,且近期世界盃結束後人潮返國及7至8月學校假期等因素。該國已針對特定地區擴大疫苗接種對象為6個月至59歲族群,防止疫情向外擴散。 美洲地區疫情持續,自今年截至7/25,共17國/地區累計報告4 萬7,026例確定病例及48例死亡(CFR:0.10%),病例數較去年同期增加5倍。其中,高達97%確定病例集中於瓜地馬拉(30,040例)、墨西哥(12,233例)、美國(2,318例)及加拿大(1,107 例)。
SrZaQQj5mzmfT7JyDIYI0A.en: Papua New Guinea's Ministry of Health declared an outbreak on 7 July this year. Across 8 provinces, 108 suspected cases (including 3 confirmed) have been reported since January this year. Because the country's laboratory testing capacity is limited, samples must be sent to Australia for testing, which may underestimate the actual spread. In addition, cases are geographically dispersed with no epidemiological links, and vaccination coverage is low, so the outbreak is expected to spread. As of 31 July this year, Brazil has reported 18 confirmed measles cases, mainly in the city of São Paulo (15 cases), among children under 2 years and people aged 20 to 50 years. This is the first sustained local transmission since the country was certified as having eliminated measles. The main factors are that the area is an important hub, the return of travellers after the recently concluded World Cup, and school holidays in July and August. Brazil has expanded vaccination in specific areas to people aged 6 months to 59 years to prevent the outbreak from spreading further. Measles activity in the Region of the Americas continues. As of 25 July this year, 17 countries and territories have reported a cumulative 47,026 confirmed cases and 48 deaths (CFR: 0.10%), a five-fold increase over the same period last year. As many as 97% of confirmed cases are concentrated in Guatemala (30,040), Mexico (12,233), the United States (2,318) and Canada (1,107).

SxDoTJa8ggj5Mad7MwieHg.zh: 尚比亞疫情上升,今年1月至7月3日,全國累計報告700例疑個案(含119例確定病例與4例死亡)。目前全國10個省中已有9個省份出現確定病例,其中以西部省(Western Province)最為嚴峻。高達87.4%的確定病例無疫苗接種紀錄,當局預計於7/6-11 在5個高風險地區,針對6個月至9歲兒童展開緊急疫苗接種。 瓜地馬拉疫情嚴峻且範圍持續擴大,今年截至7/5,全國累計報告逾2萬5,700例病例,其中7,260例經實驗室確診,並有24例死亡。此波疫情源自去(114)年12月的大型宗教集會,首例個案於今(115)年1/9確診。自6月中旬迄今之3週內,快速新增近9,000 例確定病例,當局正擴大疫苗接種計畫中。 美洲地區麻疹疫情嚴峻。自今年初迄6/27止,共17國累計報告逾2萬2,900例確定病例及39例死亡,較去年同期遽增181%。逾96%確定病例集中於墨西哥(11,820例)、瓜地馬拉(7,067例)、美國(2,134例)及加拿大(1,079例)。近期疫情呈下降趨勢,第23至24週病例報告數較前2週下降51.1%,主要為墨西哥、秘魯及美國病例減少;加拿大則處於疫情低點;另瓜地馬拉恐有通報延遲情形,須謹慎解讀該國疫情趨勢。
SxDoTJa8ggj5Mad7MwieHg.en: Measles is rising in Zambia. From January to 3 July this year, 700 suspected cases have been reported nationally, including 119 confirmed cases and 4 deaths. Confirmed cases have now been identified in 9 of the country's 10 provinces, with the most severe situation in Western Province. As many as 87.4% of confirmed cases had no vaccination record. Authorities plan to carry out emergency vaccination for children aged 6 months to 9 years in 5 high-risk districts from 6 to 11 July. Guatemala's outbreak is severe and continues to expand. As of 5 July this year, more than 25,700 cases have been reported nationally, of which 7,260 were laboratory-confirmed, and 24 deaths have occurred. This wave originated from a large religious gathering in December 2025, and the first case was confirmed on 9 January 2026. In the three weeks since mid-June, nearly 9,000 confirmed cases have been added rapidly, and authorities are expanding the vaccination programme. The measles outbreak in the Region of the Americas is severe. From the start of this year to 27 June, 17 countries have reported more than 22,900 confirmed cases and 39 deaths cumulatively, a sharp 181% increase over the same period last year. More than 96% of confirmed cases are concentrated in Mexico (11,820), Guatemala (7,067), the United States (2,134) and Canada (1,079). The recent trend is declining: case reports in weeks 23–24 were 51.1% lower than in the previous two weeks, mainly because of fewer cases in Mexico, Peru and the United States. Canada is at a low point. Guatemala may have reporting delays, so its trend should be interpreted with caution.

VkvlivfRMCM6P2N6v5b_ZA.zh: 加拿大安大略省布蘭特福-布蘭特(Brantford-Brant)地區報告1例兒童感染致死的確定病例,為當地自1967年來首例本土人類感染病例。病患發病前19天於安大略省北部的小木屋度假時,熟睡中發現蝙蝠停留臉部,因無明顯傷口且蝙蝠無異常行為,家屬未尋求醫療評估及暴露後預防接種(PEP),導致病患發病死亡。
VkvlivfRMCM6P2N6v5b_ZA.en: The Brantford-Brant area in Ontario, Canada, reported a fatal confirmed rabies case in a child, the first locally acquired human infection in the area since 1967. Nineteen days before onset, while on holiday at a cabin in northern Ontario, a bat was found on the child's face while the child was asleep. As there was no obvious wound and the bat showed no abnormal behaviour, the family did not seek medical evaluation or post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), and the child later died.

Zv47-rf4Br5XvH06ckqdwQ.zh: 世界盃足球賽(FIFA) 主辦國疫情持續,  墨西哥自6/18-22新增55例確定病例。自2025年至2026/6/22止,已累計報告1萬8,440例確定病例,並導致11個州共43人死亡,其中西部哈里斯科州累計報告6,517例確定病例,為全國最高;而首都墨西哥城則累計達993例確定病例。 美國加州截至6/12報告50例確定病例,為去年度總數之兩倍,亦創下2019年以來新高。 加拿大截至6/22累計報告1,073例確定病例,專家表示頻繁的賽事跨國移動及墨國的本土疫情,疫情可能持續擴散。
Zv47-rf4Br5XvH06ckqdwQ.en: The outbreak continues in the host countries of the FIFA World Cup. Mexico reported 55 confirmed cases between 18 and 22 June. From 2025 through 22 June 2026, 18,440 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, causing 43 deaths across 11 states. Jalisco State in the west has the highest cumulative total, with 6,517 confirmed cases, while the capital, Mexico City, has reached 993 confirmed cases cumulatively. California, United States, reported 50 confirmed cases as of 12 June, twice last year's total and the highest since 2019. Canada reported 1,073 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 22 June. Experts say frequent cross-border movement during the tournament, together with the local outbreak in Mexico, may allow the outbreak to continue spreading.

quhhCVgNYud1C9if8bpuug.zh: WHO更新「洪迪亞斯號」郵輪疫情資訊,截至5/30累計報告13例病例,其中3 例死亡(致死率為23%),報告病例中有11 例確診為漢他病毒安地斯型感染,2 例為可能病例,自WHO 前於5/13 公布疫情資訊以來,共新增3例包括加拿大、荷蘭及西班牙確診病例。截至5/22 已有逾600 名接觸者進行追蹤,其中53%為高風險接觸者。WHO評估此疫情事件對全球之風險為低。
quhhCVgNYud1C9if8bpuug.en: WHO has updated information on the outbreak linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship. As of 30 May, 13 cases had been reported cumulatively, including three deaths (CFR 23%). Of the reported cases, 11 were confirmed as Andes hantavirus infection and two were probable cases. Since WHO's previous update on 13 May, three new cases have been added, in Canada, the Netherlands and Spain. As of 22 May, more than 600 contacts had been traced, 53% of them high-risk contacts. WHO assesses the global risk from this event as low.

x0YgmFJ-i4jFZr08fKzFjw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續攀升,截至5/26累計報告1,011例病例,其中105例確診、233例死亡,致死率(CFR)達23%。加拿大於5/26宣布禁止DRC與烏干達之公民入境,禁令為期90天;泰國5/26宣布自DRC與烏干達入境之旅客須進行21天入境檢疫;印度於各大機場啟動篩檢與監測措施,5/26報告1例自烏干達境外移入之疑病例,於5/27檢驗呈陰性,已排除風險。
x0YgmFJ-i4jFZr08fKzFjw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to grow: as of 26 May, 1,011 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 105 confirmed cases and 233 deaths, with a CFR of 23%. On 26 May, Canada announced a 90-day entry ban on citizens of the DRC and Uganda. On the same day, Thailand announced that travellers entering from the DRC and Uganda must undergo 21 days of entry quarantine. India has launched screening and surveillance measures at major airports; on 26 May it reported one suspected case imported from Uganda, which tested negative on 27 May, so the risk was ruled out.

jA19YS3l7s_BCt797OqE2Q.zh: 加拿大曼托巴省(Manitoba)疫情更新,自去(2025)年11月起截至4/26累計報告601例病例,其中133例住院、3例死亡,病患以年輕族群為主,其中,街友與用藥者之感染數上升。當局已發布多次警告,呼籲民眾加強個人衛生與疫苗接種等防疫措施。
jA19YS3l7s_BCt797OqE2Q.en: Manitoba, Canada: the outbreak update reports 601 cumulative cases from November 2025 through 26 April, including 133 hospitalisations and three deaths. Most patients are young people. Infections among people experiencing homelessness and people who use drugs have risen. Authorities have issued repeated warnings and urge people to strengthen personal hygiene and get vaccinated.

1S8MV12w8G6NqZVpJtqFqw.zh: 加拿大於5/17公布,1名正在卑詩省接受檢疫的國際郵輪「洪迪亞斯號」乘客,確診感染安地斯型病毒,其於3天前出現發熱、頭痛等輕微症狀,隨後被送醫院,檢測結果呈陽性,正接受隔離治療,尚未發現其他病例。該國所有高風險接觸者(10名)均已安排檢疫觀察,另有26名曾與確診病例搭乘同一航班者亦被要求進行健康監測。
1S8MV12w8G6NqZVpJtqFqw.en: Canada announced on 17 May that a passenger on the international cruise ship MV Hondius, who was undergoing quarantine in British Columbia, had tested positive for Andes virus infection. The passenger had developed mild symptoms such as fever and headache three days earlier, was then taken to hospital, and tested positive. The patient is receiving isolation treatment, and no other cases have been found. All 10 high-risk contacts in the country have been placed under quarantine observation, and 26 people who had been on the same flight as the confirmed case have also been asked to undergo health monitoring.

t1D8RlF17mVvFeuJaU6jPw.zh: 加拿大安大略省漢密爾頓市爆發群聚疫情,自今年5/4起,當地已累計報告13例確診病例。疫情集中於該市東部區域,當局正積極調查包含附近冷卻水塔等潛在暴露來源,目前尚未確認共同感染源,並已通知當地醫院提高警覺。當局呼籲50歲以上與免疫力低下等高風險族群提高警覺。
t1D8RlF17mVvFeuJaU6jPw.en: A cluster outbreak has occurred in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada, since 4 May this year, with 13 confirmed cases reported cumulatively locally. The outbreak is concentrated in the eastern part of the city. Authorities are actively investigating potential exposure sources, including nearby cooling towers. No common source has yet been confirmed, and local hospitals have been notified to remain alert. Authorities urge high-risk groups, including people aged 50 and over and people with weakened immunity, to be vigilant.

9G0LeTYB1366Vnz1FmGS-g.zh: 孟加拉爆發20年來最嚴重疫情,今年截至5/11止,全國累計報告逾5萬例疑病例(350例死亡)及6,937例確診病例(65例死亡),累計近3.6萬例住院。疫情遍及全國,以達卡專區最為嚴峻。疫情爆發主因係常規疫苗覆蓋率長期低於95%,且兒童營養不良加劇重症風險。當局自4月起推動全國緊急疫苗接種,惟每日仍有逾千例新增報告,社區傳播風險持續。 加拿大今年截至4月底已累計逾900例確診,以中部曼托巴省為多,該省報告622例(549例確診;佔全國61%),其中46例住院(含4例重症),半數為10歲以下兒童,暫無死亡病例。該國過往每年平均僅報告約91例,惟2025年病例數激增至5,425例,致於當年底被撤銷「消除麻疹國家認證」。目前流行株與去年同為D8基因型,顯示社區傳播持續,疫情風險仍高。
9G0LeTYB1366Vnz1FmGS-g.en: Bangladesh is experiencing its most severe measles outbreak in 20 years. As of 11 May this year, more than 50,000 suspected cases (350 deaths) and 6,937 confirmed cases (65 deaths) had been reported nationwide, with nearly 36,000 hospitalisations cumulatively. The outbreak has spread across the country and is most severe in the Dhaka division. The outbreak was driven mainly by routine vaccination coverage remaining below 95% for a long time, and child malnutrition has increased the risk of severe disease. Since April, authorities have launched nationwide emergency vaccination, but more than 1,000 new cases are still reported each day, and community transmission risk continues. Canada reported more than 900 confirmed cases this year as of the end of April, mainly in the central province of Manitoba. Manitoba reported 622 cases (549 confirmed; 61% of the national total), of which 46 were hospitalised, including four severe cases. Half are children aged 10 and under, and there have been no deaths so far. Canada previously reported an average of about 91 cases a year, but cases surged to 5,425 in 2025, and the country lost its measles elimination status at the end of that year. The circulating strain is genotype D8, the same as last year, indicating continued community transmission and ongoing high risk.

-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.en: PAHO issued a measles outbreak alert for the Americas. In weeks 1–3 of this year, 7 countries in the Americas reported 1,031 confirmed cases: Mexico (740), the United States (171), Canada (67), Guatemala (41), Bolivia (10), Chile (1) and Uruguay (1). This is a 43-fold increase over the 23 cases in the same period last year. Of these cases, 73% were unvaccinated and 11% had unknown vaccination history. Cases were mainly concentrated among adolescents and young adults, and incidence was highest among infants under 1 year, followed by children aged 1–4 and 5–9 years. Last year, 13 countries in the region reported 14,891 confirmed cases, compared with 466 in 2024; cases have continued to increase over the past five years, and many countries continue to report outbreaks. PAHO calls on countries to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, vaccination and emergency outbreak control measures to stop transmission. Europe reported 7,655 cases across 30 countries last year, including 8 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Romania (4,198), France (877), the Netherlands (534), Italy (529) and Spain (426). Of these, 79.9% were unvaccinated, and cases were most numerous among children under 5 years (40%). ECDC said last year's case numbers declined from 2024 (more than 35,000), but remain about twice the 2023 level. Because measles infections usually peak in late winter and early spring, it urges people to check that they have completed their vaccinations. Kazakhstan reported 1,951 confirmed cases in January this year, most in Astana (581), Zhambyl Region in the southeast (339) and Almaty city in the southeast (317). Of these, 79% were unvaccinated. Authorities say refusal of vaccination is the main cause of the outbreak, and urge parents to confirm children's vaccination status and vaccinate them promptly under the national immunization programme. The outbreak is severe in Aktobe Region in the west, which reported more than 100 cases in a single month, mainly among children under 3 years; 24 children are being treated in hospital.

TYTqT-VQnFpoSwW_iMJFwQ.en: Situation update: in week 2 (5–11 January), global test positivity rose to 4.13%, with notable increases in the Western Pacific, European and South-East Asia Regions (WHO FluNet). Australia's situation is fluctuating; test positivity was 1.78% in week 2, and the recent predominant variant is NB.1.8.1 (45.8%) (Australian CDC, 9 January; WHO, 27 January). In Europe, outpatient test positivity rose to 3.4% in week 3 of this year; XFG was the predominant variant (54%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (21%) (ECDC, 28 January). Canada's situation is rising; test positivity was 5.4% in week 2 (11–17 January), with patients mostly aged 65 and over (57%), and XFG is the main variant (Government of Canada, 23 January). Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently accounts for the highest share of circulating variants globally. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat (WHO, 2 December; WHO, 27 January).

PPWVsIJkd475h4idOg3M1Q.zh: 加拿大安大略省北部卡什契文(Kashechewan)爆發疫情,截至1/22累計至少44例檢驗陽性個案,推測實際病例數可能更高。懷疑因當地水處理廠故障,造成緊急公共衛生及安全問題,目前已有數百居民撤離,感染來源調查中。
PPWVsIJkd475h4idOg3M1Q.en: An outbreak has occurred in Kashechewan in northern Ontario, Canada. As of 22 January, at least 44 test-positive cases had been recorded, and the actual number may be higher. The outbreak is suspected to be linked to a failure at the local water treatment plant, which has caused an urgent public health and safety problem. Several hundred residents have been evacuated, and the source of infection is under investigation.

psChlvrOPANJm2miB8QQmg.zh: 加拿大1/25報告23例病例,其中5例住院,病患分布於8個省份,年齡介於1-87歲,最早於2025年10月發病,檢測血清型別為O26;經當局調查,疑感染源為某生產商的11種披薩食品,產品已下架。
psChlvrOPANJm2miB8QQmg.en: Canada reported 23 cases on 25 January, 5 of whom were hospitalised. Cases are spread across 8 provinces, aged 1 to 87 years, with the earliest onset in October 2025. Serotype O26 was identified. Authorities' investigation suggests the source is 11 pizza products from one manufacturer, and the products have been removed from sale.

4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.zh: WHO於12/10報告今(2025)年截至11/30,全球季節性流感自10月起活動度上升,目前全球流行以 A(H3N2) 為主,另自8月起,多國之K分支檢出率上升,北半球部分國家的流感季較往年提早,南半球部分國家的流感季節較往年延長。西太平洋區自10 月起活動度增加,日本及韓國提早進入流感季,紐西蘭及斐濟活動度處高峰或上升, GISAID資料顯示截至11/21,西太平洋區之病毒序列有89%為K分支;東南亞地區自6月上升,8月達高峰後趨緩,惟部分國家活動度仍偏高,另GISAID資料顯示泊爾、印度、泰國已檢出K分支;北美洲地區活動度上升,美國及加拿大K分支檢出率增加;歐洲地區部份國家第45-46 週陽性率超過10%,流感季較往年提前約4週開始,其中西歐較早上升,65 歲以上住院比例增加;WHO 評估全球流感活動度上升仍在預期範圍,流感病毒與其他呼吸道病毒共同流行,可能對醫療系統造成壓力,多國已檢出A(H3N2) K分支,目前證據未顯示K分支有致疾病嚴重度提升之情形,疫苗仍預期能降低重症風險。
4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.en: WHO reported on 10 December that, as of 30 November this year, global seasonal influenza activity has risen since October, with A(H3N2) currently predominant worldwide. Since August, detection of subclade K has increased in several countries. Some northern hemisphere countries' flu seasons began earlier than usual, and some southern hemisphere countries' seasons were longer than usual. In the Western Pacific Region, activity has increased since October, with Japan and South Korea entering the flu season early; New Zealand and Fiji are at or rising towards peak activity. GISAID data show that as of 21 November, 89% of virus sequences in the Western Pacific Region belonged to subclade K. In Southeast Asia, activity rose from June, peaked in August and then eased, although activity remains high in some countries; GISAID data show subclade K has been detected in Nepal, India and Thailand. In North America, activity has risen, with increased subclade K detection in the United States and Canada. In some European countries, test positivity exceeded 10% in weeks 45–46; the flu season began about four weeks earlier than usual, with Western Europe rising first, and hospitalisation among people aged 65 and over has increased. WHO assesses that the rise in global influenza activity is within the expected range. Influenza viruses are circulating alongside other respiratory viruses, which may put pressure on health systems. Several countries have detected A(H3N2) subclade K. Current evidence does not show that subclade K causes more severe disease, and vaccines are still expected to reduce the risk of severe illness.

Sq1m_Pl2QuPJuY0kKiQCbA.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第47週(11/17-23)全球陽性率略升至5.21%,其中東南亞區署陽性率增加。 WHO公告BA.3.2為監測中變異株(VUM),BA.3.2為Omicron BA.3的後代譜系,首例於2024年11/22檢出,截至今年11/9全球有7個國家提報86例BA.3.2序列資訊,在2025年第45週全球變異株中占1.7%,較第42週0.2%上升;WHO評估BA.3.2具顯著抗體逃脫能力,惟造成疾病嚴重度為低,整體評估風險為低,仍需持續監測。 韓國疫情於低點,第49週(11/30-12/6)報告住院降至106例,陽性率降為1.8%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 加拿大疫情從低點略升,第48週報告1,964例病例,陽性率略升至6.6%,各年齡層疫情皆上升,並以65歲以上為多,變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期略升,其中東南亞區署呈上升趨勢;近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(59%),其次為NB.1.8.1(19%),新公告的BA.3.2占約5%。鑑於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理。
Sq1m_Pl2QuPJuY0kKiQCbA.en: Situation update: global test positivity rose slightly to 5.21% in week 47 of 2025 (17–23 November), with increases in the South-East Asia Region. WHO has designated BA.3.2 as a variant under monitoring (VUM). BA.3.2 is a descendant lineage of Omicron BA.3; it was first detected on 22 November 2024. As of 9 November this year, 7 countries had submitted 86 BA.3.2 sequences. In week 45 of 2025, BA.3.2 accounted for 1.7% of global variants, up from 0.2% in week 42. WHO assesses that BA.3.2 has significant antibody escape, but causes low disease severity, and its overall risk is assessed as low; continued monitoring is needed. South Korea's situation is at a low level: hospital admissions fell to 106 in week 49 (30 November–6 December), and test positivity fell to 1.8%, with NB.1.8.1 the most common variant. Canada's situation rose slightly from a low: 1,964 cases were reported in week 48, and test positivity rose slightly to 6.6%. Cases increased in all age groups, mainly among those aged 65 and over, with XFG the most common variant. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has recently risen slightly, with an upward trend in the South-East Asia Region. XFG is currently the most common global variant (59%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (19%), and the newly announced BA.3.2 accounts for about 5%. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat.

Gi_THUiL6z1tSi80-hqokQ.zh: 中國整體疫情持續上升,第49週定點ILI門急診就診率為9.9%,高於近3年同期,陽性率為49.8%,主要流行型別為A(H3N2);當局表示流感疫情處於高度流行,華東/華南/西南地區之部分省份流感活動持續上升,另陽性率呈上升趨勢,惟上升幅度趨緩,其中5-14歲年齡層之陽性率高於其他年齡層,呼籲幼托、學校及養老院等機構應加強健康監測,及早發現/處理群聚疫情,另民眾應落實個人衛生防護措施。 英國疫情上升,近1週平均每日住院人數為2,660人,較前1週增加逾50%,住院人數以75歲以上及5歲以下年齡層為多,陽性率則以5-14歲年齡層為高,當局表示疫情尚未達高點,預估短期內可能上升至逾5,000人,本流感季提早1個月爆發,主因為H3N2病毒K分支流行,致民眾缺乏既有免疫力,導致傳播加速。 加拿大疫情上升,第48週報告3,655例病例,較前1週增加逾67%,陽性率為13%,高於去年同期(2%),其中以19歲以下年齡層為高。另住院率、群聚爆發數皆呈上升,主要流行型別為A(H3N2),另該國自9/1起,已檢出47件H3N2病毒K分支,專家表示疫苗仍具保護力,呼籲民眾儘速接種疫苗。
Gi_THUiL6z1tSi80-hqokQ.en: China's overall outbreak continues to rise. In week 49, the sentinel ILI outpatient and emergency visit rate was 9.9%, higher than the same period over the past three years, with test positivity of 49.8%; A(H3N2) is the main circulating type. Authorities say influenza is at a high level of circulation; activity continues to rise in some provinces in East, South and Southwest China, and positivity is rising, though more slowly. Test positivity among those aged 5–14 is higher than in other age groups. Authorities call on nurseries, schools and elderly care homes to strengthen health monitoring and detect and manage clusters early, and urge the public to implement personal hygiene protection measures. The United Kingdom's situation is rising: the average daily number of hospitalised patients in the past week was 2,660, an increase of more than 50% from the previous week. Hospitalisations are highest among those aged 75 and over and under 5, while test positivity is highest among those aged 5–14. Authorities say the outbreak has not yet peaked and could rise to more than 5,000 patients in the short term. This flu season began a month early, mainly because the K subclade of H3N2 is circulating, leaving people without existing immunity and accelerating transmission. Canada's situation is rising: 3,655 cases were reported in week 48, an increase of more than 67% from the previous week, with test positivity of 13%, higher than the same period last year (2%), highest among those under 19. Hospitalisation rates and outbreak numbers have also risen, and the main circulating type is A(H3N2). Since 1 September, 47 H3N2 subclade K viruses have been detected in Canada. Experts say vaccines still provide protection and urge people to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

5gUqvOQQoj166nkryh_e0A.zh: 加拿大疫情更新,今年截至11/29共10省報告4,926例確定病例,其中2例死亡,單週(第48週)新增37例病例,主要分布於安大略省及亞伯達省,89%病患未接種疫苗,另當地媒體表示亞伯達省有病例數低估情形。
5gUqvOQQoj166nkryh_e0A.en: Canada update: as of 29 November this year, 10 provinces had reported 4,926 confirmed cases, including 2 deaths. 37 new cases were added in week 48 alone. Cases are mainly in Ontario and Alberta, and 89% of patients were unvaccinated. Local media say cases are under-reported in Alberta.

ByHqodPAO0_F5zCuvlXmjQ.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第45週(11/3-9)全球陽性率6.15%,僅非洲區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第46週(11/10-16)定醫平均報告數1.91,較近2週下降,病患分布以北海道、愛知縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 歐洲疫情下降,第46週整體陽性率為6.1%,距第38週高峰(陽性率24.4%)已明顯下降,以變異株XFG占比最高(66%),其次為NB.1.8.1(12%)。 加拿大疫情下降,第46週陽性率降至6.4%,且低於近2年同期,65歲以上病患占6成,變異株XFG占比最高。 南非疫情上升,第46週私立機構陽性率約20%,符合低度流行閾,死亡率亦上升,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,惟非洲區署呈上升;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
ByHqodPAO0_F5zCuvlXmjQ.en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 45 of 2025 (3–9 November) was 6.15%; only the African Region saw an increase in positivity. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 46 (10–16 November), the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 1.91, lower than in the previous two weeks. Cases are concentrated in Hokkaido and Aichi prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Europe: The outbreak is declining. The overall positivity rate in week 46 was 6.1%, markedly lower than the week 38 peak of 24.4%; the variant XFG has the highest share (66%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (12%). Canada: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate fell to 6.4% in week 46, lower than the same period in the past two years; patients aged 65 and over account for 60%, and the variant XFG has the highest share. South Africa: The outbreak is rising. In week 46, the positivity rate at private facilities was about 20%, meeting the low-level epidemic threshold, and mortality has also risen; the variant XFG has the highest share. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been declining, but the African Region is rising. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

0Q8G9y9SBvW1tGaXVpeNaA.zh: 加拿大於11/10宣布PAHO通知該國不再維持自1998以來之麻疹消除狀態,該國自去(2024)年10月起爆發大規模跨區疫情,今(2025)年截至11/1共計10地區報告4,800例確診病例,其中2例死亡,雖近期疫情趨緩,惟已持續超過12個月,主要集中在疫苗接種率較低之社區,經PAHO委員會審查近期流行病學及實驗室數據,證實該國境內同一病毒株已持續傳播1年以上,當局已加強與PAHO及各地方政府合作,以提高疫苗接種率及強化監測措施。 澳大利亞西澳大利亞州今年截至11/6報告54例確診病例,主要分布於西南部和南部地區,病患皆有東南/南亞國外旅遊史或確診病例接觸史,為該州30年以來最嚴重疫情,2023-24年僅報告6例病例,當局已公布確定病例曾暴露之風險場所,建議造訪民眾應監測自身症狀。 紐西蘭今年截至11/7報告18例確診病例,近期新增病例多為本土病例,其中包含7例為藍橋渡輪(Bluebridge Ferry)群聚事件,當局已匡列逾3,000名接觸者,並提醒民眾疫情持續,建議民眾自身評估接種疫苗並密切留意相關症狀。 以色列今年截至11/10累計報告1,935例,其中9例死亡,疫情已傳播至少12個城市,當局已擴大疫苗接種資,並提醒倘出現相關症狀時,應立即就醫,另未完整接種疫苗者應避免參與爆發疫情城市之集會活動。
0Q8G9y9SBvW1tGaXVpeNaA.en: On 10 November, Canada announced that PAHO had notified it that it no longer maintains measles elimination status, which it had held since 1998. The country has experienced a large-scale, multi-regional outbreak since October 2024. As of 1 November this year, 10 regions had reported 4,800 confirmed cases, including 2 deaths. Although the outbreak has slowed recently, it has persisted for more than 12 months, mainly in communities with lower vaccination rates. After the PAHO commission reviewed recent epidemiological and laboratory data, it confirmed that the same virus strain had been circulating in the country for more than one year. Authorities have strengthened cooperation with PAHO and local governments to raise vaccination rates and enhance surveillance. Australia: In Western Australia, 54 confirmed cases had been reported as of 6 November this year, mainly in the south-western and southern regions. All patients had either travel history to countries in South-East or South Asia or contact with a confirmed case. This is the state's most severe outbreak in 30 years; only six cases were reported in 2023–24. Authorities have published venues where confirmed cases were exposed, and recommend that visitors monitor their own symptoms. New Zealand: As of 7 November this year, 18 confirmed cases had been reported. Recent new cases are mostly locally acquired, including 7 cases from a Bluebridge Ferry cluster. Authorities have traced more than 3,000 contacts and reminded the public that the outbreak continues, recommending that people assess their own vaccination status and watch closely for related symptoms. Israel: As of 10 November this year, 1,935 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 9 deaths. The outbreak has spread to at least 12 cities. Authorities have expanded vaccination and reminded people to seek medical care immediately if symptoms appear. People who are not fully vaccinated should avoid gatherings in cities with outbreaks.

HiTeWfCNz6VN_UMlgl2rmw.zh: 加拿大於10/17報告31例病例,分布於4個省份,介於2-9月發病;經調查,許多病患係用手餵狗吃飼料後12-72小時發病,疑感染源為某製造商生產之豬肉/牛肉/雞肉飼料,當局呼籲民眾餵食完寵物後應洗手,並妥善保存飼料。
HiTeWfCNz6VN_UMlgl2rmw.en: Canada reported 31 cases on 17 October, distributed across four provinces, with onset between February and September. Investigation found that many patients became ill 12–72 hours after hand-feeding dog food. The suspected source is pork, beef and chicken pet food produced by a certain manufacturer. Authorities urge people to wash their hands after feeding pets and to store pet food properly.

IwXkSCUbOrXCMu5a6xrgUw.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第40週(9/29-10/5)全球陽性率14.84%,其中,歐洲及非洲區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第41週定醫平均報告數3.72,已連續4週下降,住院數亦呈下降趨勢,病患地理分布以東京都、神奈川縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情下降,第40週陽性率12.61%,較9月初高峰(38.95%)已明顯下降,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 美洲疫情上升,第40週整體陽性率增至10.7%,其中,中、南美洲陽性率上升,北美洲及加勒比海陽性率下降。 加拿大疫情呈下降趨勢,第41週新增2,359例病例,陽性率降至8.7%,已連續2週下降,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,歐洲及非洲區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
IwXkSCUbOrXCMu5a6xrgUw.en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 40 of 2025 (29 September–5 October) was 14.84%, with positivity increasing in the European and African regional offices. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 41, the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 3.72, having declined for four consecutive weeks, and hospitalizations are also declining. Cases are concentrated in Tokyo and Kanagawa prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. South Korea: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 40 was 12.61%, markedly lower than the early-September peak of 38.95%; the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Americas: The outbreak is rising. The overall positivity rate in week 40 rose to 10.7%, with positivity increasing in Central and South America and decreasing in North America and the Caribbean. Canada: The outbreak is declining. In week 41, 2,359 new cases were reported and the positivity rate fell to 8.7%, the second consecutive week of decline; the variant XFG has the highest share. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown an upward trend, with the European and African regional offices rising. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

KuW3ik2ISS6iTDYkMbN2Ng.zh: 加拿大10/12報告105例病例,其中16例住院,病患分布於安大略及魁北克等省份;疑感染源為某生產商製造的開心果及甜點,當局已要求產品下架。 英國今年4-6月累計報告2,342例病例,雖與去年同期(2,387例)相當,但較今年1-3月(1,591例)增加47%。
KuW3ik2ISS6iTDYkMbN2Ng.en: Canada reported 105 cases on 12 October, of which 16 were hospitalized. Patients are distributed across provinces including Ontario and Quebec. The suspected source is pistachios and desserts produced by a certain manufacturer, and authorities have requested that the products be removed from shelves. -yt0AevpHQbxeWt673kDSA.en: Weekly summary. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 10 countries reported 19 H5N1 outbreaks between 28 September and 3 October 2025: Spain 5, Austria and United Kingdom 3 each, Mexico 2, and Germany, Latvia, Czechia, Poland, Italy and Portugal 1 each. Iceland reported 2 H5N5 outbreaks on 26 September 2025. US dairy cattle infections: Cumulatively since March last year, 1,080 (0) outbreaks have been reported across 18 states, mainly concentrated recently in Nebraska. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 38, 432 sampling sites provided test reports, and three states (New Jersey, California and Oregon) had a total of three sampling sites detect H5-positive results. Annual summary: Human cases this year: 1 H5 (including presumptive) influenza; 28 H5N1 influenza (991* cumulative since 2003); 26 H9N2 influenza (156 cumulative); 2 H10N3 influenza (6 cumulative). Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 59 countries and areas have reported 2,365 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Other updates: The WHO Strategic Advisory Group of Experts on Immunization (SAGE) recommended at its meeting that countries may issue targeted recommendations for use of existing licensed A(H5) vaccines according to avian influenza exposure risk. Priority groups include laboratory workers handling H5 viruses, first-line responders in zoonotic influenza outbreaks, healthcare workers who assess and care for suspected or confirmed cases, and people who continue to have contact with animals and their environments in areas where animal and human infections have been reported. The Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA) announced on 26 September that genotype D1.3 had been detected at an ostrich farm in British Columbia. This genotype is linked to infections among poultry farm workers in Ohio, USA, and genetic testing shows the samples are direct ancestors of the Ohio and Missouri samples, suggesting the virus spread from this farm to the United States. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH conducted a risk assessment of H5 viruses on 28 July. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses; human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk to the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the mode and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoiding drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response measures.

WHO reports that as of 6 June this year, more than 180,000 suspected and 88,000 confirmed cases have been reported globally. Cases are mainly in the capital, Bishkek, Osh Region in the south and Chui Region in the north, and recently cases have also continued to rise in Jalal-Abad Region in the west. The country has not declared an outbreak; the main cause is that many children are unvaccinated. In Japan, Kanagawa Prefecture reported one teenager, who visited Expo 2025 Osaka on 21 June and stayed at the venue for about 6 hours, developed symptoms that day, and was confirmed on 3 July. The patient had no recent overseas travel, and the contact history is unknown. Authorities and the organizers urge those who visited on that day to monitor their health.

dGiTC-Xc334Dmthz0Ichew.zh: 北美疫情更新,美國截至6/19共36州報告1,214例及3例死亡,並報告23起疫情;加拿大截至6/23共9省3,381例,其中1例死亡,病例數以安大略省逾2,100例為多,其次為亞伯達省960餘例,該國近期呈下降趨勢,今年病例數為1998年以來最高;墨西哥今年截至6/7累計報告5,584例,其中2,153例確診及4例死亡,病例數以赤瓦瓦州逾2,000例為多。
dGiTC-Xc334Dmthz0Ichew.en: North American measles update: As of 19 June, the United States has reported 1,214 cases in 36 states, including 3 deaths, and 23 outbreaks. As of 23 June, Canada has reported 3,381 cases in 9 provinces, including 1 death. Ontario has the most, with more than 2,100 cases, followed by Alberta with more than 960. Cases in Canada have recently trended downward, but this year's case count is the highest since 1998. As of 7 June this year, Mexico has cumulatively reported 5,584 cases, of which 2,153 were confirmed and 4 died. Chihuahua State has the most, with more than 2,000 cases.

byN5Yzc77ZpAwLeyx-r4lA.zh: 加拿大安大略省報告該國今年首例死亡案例,為該省西南部一名新生兒,於出生前經由母親垂直感染,母親未接種MMR疫苗,當局表示該新生兒除麻疹感染外,亦有其他非傳染病併發症。該省今年截至6/3已報告逾2,000例,其中超過1,700例確診,該省於去年5月報告1例兒童死亡案例。
byN5Yzc77ZpAwLeyx-r4lA.en: Ontario, Canada, reported the country's first measles death this year: a newborn in the southwest of the province who was infected in utero through vertical transmission from a mother who had not received the MMR vaccine. Authorities said the newborn also had other non-communicable complications in addition to measles infection. As of 3 June, the province had reported more than 2,000 cases this year, of which over 1,700 were confirmed. The province reported one child death case last May.

1kovSZBbxd8mSzsk34XkiA.zh: 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/22報告14起疫情,累計31州1,046例,其中127例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,惟近期疫情已趨緩,然其他州仍持續報告零星病例,愛荷華州及內布拉斯加州報告今年首例;加拿大今年截至5/17共9省2,515例,以安大略省(1,848)為多,其次為亞伯達省(509),近期中部曼托巴省/薩斯喀徹溫省病例數亦快速增加,預估疫情將持續至夏季。 阿富汗疫情嚴峻,今年迄今報告5.5萬餘例及357例死亡(CFR : 0.6%),自年初以來病例數呈穩定上升趨勢,於第16週達最高峰,疫情高於前3年(2022-24年)平均,發病率以該國南部赫爾曼德省最高,由於該國政局不穩及醫療基礎設施不足,嚴重影響疫苗接種及疫情控制等措施之推動。
1kovSZBbxd8mSzsk34XkiA.en: North America update: as of 22 May this year, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,046 cases cumulatively across 31 states, including 127 hospitalizations and 3 deaths. Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. Although the outbreak in Texas has recently slowed, other states continue to report sporadic cases, and Iowa and Nebraska reported their first cases this year. As of 17 May, Canada had 2,515 cases across 9 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (1,848), followed by Alberta (509). Case numbers have also risen rapidly recently in the central provinces of Manitoba and Saskatchewan, and the outbreak is expected to continue into the summer. Afghanistan's outbreak is severe: this year more than 55,000 cases and 357 deaths (CFR 0.6%) have been reported. Cases have risen steadily since the beginning of the year and peaked in week 16, higher than the average for the previous three years (2022–24). Incidence is highest in Helmand Province in the south of the country. Political instability and insufficient medical infrastructure have seriously hampered vaccination and outbreak control efforts.

JCIMsu3ZrubeLl8KjXXT0Q.zh: 加拿大魁北克省(Québec)今年截至5/14累計報告61例病例,主要分布於埃斯特里區26例,今年病例數與去年同期68例相當,該省近15年來病例數呈上升趨勢,去年全年累計834例為近10年來最高,預期今年病例數仍會持續增加,推測疫情上升為氣候變化所致。
JCIMsu3ZrubeLl8KjXXT0Q.en: In Quebec, Canada, 61 cases have been reported cumulatively this year as of 14 May, with 26 cases in the Estrie region. This year's count is comparable to the 68 cases reported in the same period last year. Case numbers in the province have risen over the past 15 years, and last year's full-year total of 834 cases was the highest in nearly 10 years. Case numbers are expected to keep increasing this year, and the rise is presumed to be due to climate change.

Mw_nMxlTzJ2K1ZVC0TfFyQ.zh: 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/15報告14起疫情,累計31州1,024例,其中126例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多;加拿大今年截至5/3共7省1,846例,以安大略省(1,460)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)疫情嚴峻,今年迄今報告1,300餘例。 烏克蘭疫情上升,今年至3月報告472例,較去(2024)年增加20.5倍,並報告2例兒童死亡,病例集中於西部地區之外喀爾巴阡/車夫契/敖得薩州,由於當地戰事持續使公共衛生服務受到干擾,降低疫苗接種率,且人口流動加劇疾病傳播風險。
Mw_nMxlTzJ2K1ZVC0TfFyQ.en: North America update: as of 15 May this year, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,024 cases cumulatively across 31 states, including 126 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. As of 3 May, Canada had 1,846 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (1,460), and case numbers in Alberta have also risen rapidly. In northern Mexico, the outbreak in Chihuahua State is severe, with more than 1,300 cases reported so far this year. Ukraine's outbreak is rising: 472 cases were reported through March this year, a 20.5-fold increase compared with last year, and 2 child deaths have been reported. Cases are concentrated in the western oblasts of Zakarpattia, Chernivtsi and Odesa. Ongoing conflict in the area is disrupting public health services and lowering vaccination rates, and population movement is increasing the risk of spread.

MtnoDj3DtXCdMWVpRQnxxA.zh: 中南美洲近年病例數上升,巴拿馬/哥斯大黎加/加拉瓜/宏都拉斯/瓜地馬拉/薩爾瓦多/墨西哥等國均有人類感染病例。另加拿大於今年3月報告1例80歲男性病例,具哥斯大黎加旅遊史,顯示其可能透過國際旅遊傳播,增加國際傳播風險。螺旋蠅為寄生性蠅類,其幼蟲可寄生於人類及動物之傷口或天然腔道,造成「蠅蛆症」,目前無疫苗或特效藥物。
MtnoDj3DtXCdMWVpRQnxxA.en: Human infections have increased in Central and South America in recent years, with human cases reported in Panama, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Mexico and other countries. In addition, Canada reported a case in an 80-year-old man in March this year who had a travel history to Costa Rica, indicating that the disease may spread through international travel and increase the risk of international transmission. The screwworm fly is a parasitic fly whose larvae can parasitize wounds or natural body cavities of humans and animals, causing myiasis. There is currently no vaccine or specific drug.

JID15r3l9zYEN3QeVd_R_w.zh: 摩洛哥自2023年10月爆發疫情以來,截至今年4/13全國共12個地區報告2.5萬餘例疑病例,其中1.3萬餘例確診及184例死亡,該國於今年1月下旬達高峰後,已連續10週呈下降趨勢,經基因定序顯示多為B3基因型,該基因型於非洲地區流行,亦與全球疫情相關。目前疫情已受控制,惟部分地區仍持續傳播,惟該國麻疹-德國麻疹(MR)疫苗接種率僅73.6%,WHO評估該國未接種疫苗/未完全接種疫苗者與免疫功能低下者風險為「中」,由於處非/歐洲交接處,人員流動頻繁,評估區域及全球風險為「中」。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/8報告14起疫情,累計31州1,001例,其中126例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,今年僅4個多月,病例數已接近2019年全年病例數(1,274),其為1992年以來病例數最高峰;加拿大今年截至4/26共7省1,506例,以安大略省(1,249)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升,截至5/12累計報告362例;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)疫情嚴峻,今年迄今報告954例,其中1例死亡,該國今年迄今累計1,003例。 澳大利亞爆發近6年來最嚴重疫情,今年迄今累計報告72例,超過去(2024)年全年病例數(57例),分布以維多利亞州27例為多,其次為新南威爾斯州(21)及西澳大利亞州(18),超過6成病例為29歲以下族群。
JID15r3l9zYEN3QeVd_R_w.en: Morocco: since its outbreak began in October 2023, as of 13 April this year, 12 regions nationwide have reported more than 25,000 suspected cases, of which more than 13,000 were confirmed and 184 died. The country peaked in late January this year and has since declined for 10 consecutive weeks. Genetic sequencing shows that most cases are genotype B3, which circulates in Africa and is also linked to the global outbreak. The outbreak is now under control, but transmission continues in some areas. Morocco's measles-rubella (MR) vaccination coverage is only 73.6%. WHO assesses the risk for unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated people and immunocompromised people in the country as moderate. Because the country sits at the junction of Africa and Europe with frequent population movement, the regional and global risk is also assessed as moderate. North America update: as of 8 May, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,001 cases cumulatively across 31 states, including 126 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. In just over four months this year, case numbers are close to the 2019 full-year total (1,274), the highest since 1992. As of 26 April, Canada had 1,506 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (1,249); Alberta's case numbers have risen rapidly, with 362 cases reported cumulatively as of 12 May. The outbreak in Chihuahua State in northern Mexico is severe, with 954 cases reported this year so far, including 1 death; the country has reported 1,003 cases so far this year. Australia is experiencing its most severe outbreak in nearly six years, with 72 cases reported so far this year, exceeding last year's full-year total (57 cases). Victoria had the most (27 cases), followed by New South Wales (21) and Western Australia (18). More than 60% of cases were aged 29 years or younger.

_hBZvvXeD0LHv_96v1rtKw.zh: 加拿大蒙特婁2024年全年報告556例病例,較2014年(348例)增加60%。過去10年間,女性病例數顯著上升,自2014年14例增至2024年56例,當局表示此上升趨勢可能衍生先天性梅毒病例增加。該區於2011-19年未發現先天性梅毒病例,惟自2020年起每年報告1-7例。
_hBZvvXeD0LHv_96v1rtKw.en: Montreal, Canada, reported 556 cases in 2024, a 60% increase over 2014 (348 cases). Over the past 10 years, cases among women have risen significantly, from 14 in 2014 to 56 in 2024; authorities say this upward trend may lead to an increase in congenital syphilis cases. The area recorded no congenital syphilis cases in 2011–19, but has reported 1–7 cases each year since 2020.

1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.zh: 韓國今年迄今累計52例,病例數為去年同期的1.3倍,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關病例,感染國家以越南33例為多,另有烏茲別克/泰國/義大利各1例,超過60%的病例未接種疫苗或接種狀況不明,當局表示因新冠疫情後國際交流頻繁,且全球疫情持續,尤其是東南亞地區,由於持續有前往流行地區之病例輸入並造成傳播,需對境外移入風險保持警戒。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/1報告12起疫情,累計30州935例,其中121例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,北達科他州近期報告自2011年來首例;加拿大今年截至4/19共7省1,177例,以安大略省(993)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升,截至5/6累計報告287例,為該省1987年以來最高;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)病例數遽增,今年迄今報告786例,並報告1例成年男性死亡案例,該國去年同期僅報告7例。 法國今年截至4/13累計報告427例,接近去(2024)年全年病例數(483),其中,全國近60%的省份報告病例,以1-4歲兒童為多,另報告58例併發症,9例於ICU治療,並報告1例成年死亡病例。
1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.en: South Korea has reported 52 cases so far this year, 1.3 times the same period last year. All cases were imported or linked to imported cases; the countries of infection were mainly Viet Nam with 33 cases, plus 1 each in Uzbekistan, Thailand and Italy. More than 60% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Authorities said that international exchange has been frequent since the COVID-19 pandemic and the global outbreak continues, especially in Southeast Asia; because cases continue to be imported from areas with outbreaks and cause transmission, vigilance against the risk of imported cases must be maintained. North America update: as of 1 May this year, the United States has reported 12 outbreaks, with 935 cases cumulatively across 30 states, including 121 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. North Dakota recently reported its first case since 2011. As of 19 April, Canada had 1,177 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (993); case numbers in Alberta have risen rapidly, with 287 cases reported cumulatively as of 6 May, the highest for the province since 1987. In Chihuahua State in northern Mexico, case numbers have surged, with 786 cases reported this year so far, including 1 adult male death; the country reported only 7 cases in the same period last year. France reported 427 cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April, close to last year's full-year total of 483. Nearly 60% of the country's provinces have reported cases, mainly among children aged 1–4. A total of 58 complications were reported, 9 of which were treated in the ICU, and 1 adult death was reported.

J3iNpOwwErfMBULdhmEehQ.zh: WHO於4/28公布美洲今年截至4/18疫情概況,共6國報告超過2,300例,其中3例死亡,較去(2024)年同期上升11倍,以加拿大報告1,069例為多,其次為美國(800例,2例死亡)、墨西哥(421例,1例死亡),阿根廷/巴西/貝里斯報告2-21例間。因境外病例持續輸入導致疫情爆發,傳播鏈延長,影響範圍擴大,且美洲區疫苗覆蓋率不佳,僅約30%國家第一劑MMR疫苗覆蓋率超過95%目標,另新冠疫情、疫苗猶豫及醫療保健資源限制,致疫苗覆蓋率偏低,易感人群數上升。WHO評估該地區風險為高。其他區署疫情持續,且因資源限制、及公衛系統薄弱等因素,評估全球風險為中。
J3iNpOwwErfMBULdhmEehQ.en: WHO published on 28 April an overview of the Americas as of 18 April this year: 6 countries reported more than 2,300 cases, including 3 deaths, 11 times the figure for the same period last year. Canada reported the most, with 1,069 cases, followed by the United States (800 cases, 2 deaths) and Mexico (421 cases, 1 death); Argentina, Brazil and Belize reported between 2 and 21 cases each. Continuing imported cases have led to outbreaks, lengthening transmission chains and expanding the affected area. Vaccination coverage in the Americas is poor: only about 30% of countries have first-dose MMR coverage above the 95% target. In addition, the COVID-19 pandemic, vaccine hesitancy and limited healthcare resources have lowered vaccination coverage and increased the number of susceptible people. WHO assesses the risk in the region as high. Outbreaks in other regions continue, and due to resource constraints and weak public health systems, the global risk is assessed as moderate.

OZWF_6Awucwbnw2NZkfr7Q.zh: 越南近1週(4/12-4/17)新增4,100餘例疑病例,較前1週4,500餘例下降8.8%,另有2例死亡,今年迄今累計63省市報告7.6萬例,其中超過8,600例確診及10例死亡。當局表示病例數於近期呈下降趨勢,新增病例多位於北部地區,其他地區已趨緩,經大規模疫苗接種後,10歲以下病例數已趨緩,惟10歲以上仍上升。目前該國已有52個省市接種率達95%以上接種目標,然偏遠地區及都會地區接種率仍偏低,部分民眾存在疫苗猶豫及基層醫事人員不足,致疫情控制仍面臨挑戰。 吉爾吉斯疫情嚴峻,今年迄4/10報告逾5,100例,病例數遽增,當局表示民眾因宗教因素及疫苗猶豫未接種疫苗,目前依法限制未接種疫苗者進入教育機構,並呼籲民眾接種疫苗。 美國今年截至4/17共25州報告800例及3例死亡,並報告10起疫情,其中德州報告逾600例,另有3州(路易斯安那/密蘇里/維吉亞)報告今年首例;加拿大今年截至4/5共6省報告880例,以安大略省804例為多,多數病例與去年10月新布藍茲維省所爆發疫情相關,該國病例數已達1998年以來最高。
OZWF_6Awucwbnw2NZkfr7Q.en: Viet Nam update: in the most recent week (12–17 April), more than 4,100 suspected cases were reported, down 8.8% from more than 4,500 the previous week, with 2 deaths. So far this year, 76,000 cases have been reported cumulatively across 63 provinces and cities, of which more than 8,600 were confirmed and 10 died. Authorities say case numbers have declined recently; new cases are mostly in the north, and other areas have eased. After large-scale vaccination, cases among children under 10 have slowed, but cases among those over 10 are still rising. Currently 52 provinces and cities have reached the target of more than 95% vaccination coverage, but coverage remains low in remote and urban areas, and some people are hesitant about vaccines and there is a shortage of primary healthcare workers, so outbreak control still faces challenges. Kyrgyzstan's outbreak is severe: as of 10 April this year, more than 5,100 cases had been reported, and case numbers have risen rapidly. Authorities say some people have not been vaccinated for religious reasons or due to vaccine hesitancy; unvaccinated people are now legally restricted from entering educational institutions, and the public is urged to get vaccinated. The United States reported 800 cases and 3 deaths in 25 states as of 17 April this year, with 10 outbreaks reported; more than 600 cases were in Texas, and 3 other states (Louisiana, Missouri and Virginia) reported their first cases this year. As of 5 April, Canada had reported 880 cases across 6 provinces this year, 804 of them in Ontario; most cases are linked to the outbreak that broke out in New Brunswick last October, and the country's case count has reached its highest level since 1998.

HU38cvHvbvOvM2hjbm8EPg.zh: 北美疫情擴大,美國今年截至4/3累計6(新增3起)起疫情,至少22州報告逾600例,為2019年以來新高,97%病例未接種疫苗或接種史不明;德州疫情最為嚴峻,主要發生於蓋恩斯郡及西部地區,迄已累計19個郡報告逾480例,其中56例住院;加拿大今年截至3/22累計報告615例疑,其中514例確診,病例以安大略省(548例)為多。
HU38cvHvbvOvM2hjbm8EPg.en: The outbreak in North America is expanding. As of 3 April this year, the United States has recorded six outbreaks cumulatively (three new), with more than 600 cases reported in at least 22 states, the highest since 2019. 97% of cases were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Texas is the most severely affected, mainly in Gaines County and western areas; 19 counties have reported more than 480 cases cumulatively, 56 of whom were hospitalized. As of 22 March this year, Canada has reported 615 suspected cases cumulatively, of which 514 were confirmed; cases are concentrated in Ontario (548 cases).

mbqyo_nGNRdMAcj542Syxg.en: Viet Nam announced on 21 March that 63 provinces and cities have reported over 42,000 suspected cases so far this year, of which over 4,000 are confirmed, with 5 deaths. Cases are concentrated in the south (54%), followed by the central region (20%). Most cases are children aged from 9 months to under 15 years, accounting for over 70%, and over 95% were unvaccinated. Cases are currently concentrated in urban areas, but numbers are rising in mountainous provinces. Although the outbreak is expected to decline, cases will continue to occur across the country, especially in mountainous areas and provinces with low vaccination coverage. The US south-central outbreak continues: as of 25 March, 379 cases had been reported cumulatively (Texas 327, New Mexico 43, Oklahoma 9), of which 42 were hospitalized and 2 died. The United States reported that as of 20 March, 378 cases had been reported from 18 states, of which 64 were hospitalized. PAHO issued a risk assessment for the Americas on 24 March. As of 15 March, 4 countries had reported 507 cases: the United States 301 (including 2 deaths), Canada 173, Mexico 22 and Argentina 11. This is 5.5 times the 91 cases reported in the same period last year. Because the virus continues to circulate in the region, most countries have not reached the 95% vaccination coverage target, vaccination was disrupted during the COVID-19 pandemic, vaccine hesitancy has increased and access to healthcare for vulnerable groups is limited, the overall risk is assessed as high, with high confidence. Kyrgyzstan has reported 4,055 cases so far this year, including 8 child deaths. Case numbers have risen sharply in the capital Bishkek, northern Chuy Region and southern Osh Region, and over 95% of cases were unvaccinated. Kyrgyzstan reported over 14,000 cases and 6 deaths last year. The increase is mainly due to low vaccination coverage; coverage in Bishkek is only 63%.

Recently, Ontario, Quebec and British Columbia have reported cases linked to overseas travel. With the travel season under way and childhood vaccination coverage in the country declining, transmission may increase.

gYPIZchdh6adZRMNWcJmMQ.zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:美國/柬埔寨於本週各新增1例H5N1流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共15國於2024/11/9~2025/2/27間新增166起H5N1疫情,分別為美國93起、德國15起、荷蘭14起、波蘭11起、韓國9起、匈牙利7起、捷克6起、丹麥3起、比利時2起、墨西哥/義大利/瑞典/柬埔寨/保加利亞/加拿大各1起。 澳大利亞於2025/02/22新增1起H7N8疫情。 秘魯於2025/1/16-2/13新增12起H5(N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告976(3)起疫情,近期主要集中於加州、內華達州、亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少8,900例,檢測217例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。C 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中貓隻出現死亡案例。 廢水監測:第8週計389個採檢點提供檢測報告,4州10個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國更新近期3例H5N1流感人類感染病例資訊,內華達州乳牛場工人僅出現結膜炎症狀,目前已康復;俄亥俄州禽場工作人員曾參與禽流感禽場撲殺作業,而懷俄明州病患為接觸家中病死家禽,2名病患皆曾因病情嚴重住院治療,目前皆已出院。內華達州及懷俄明州病患檢體經基因檢測皆為2.3.4.4b(基因型D1.1),該基因型已於野鳥及家禽廣泛傳播,近期於內華達州及亞利桑那州乳牛中檢出,2名病患檢體皆發現於PB2蛋白中發生突變,該突變與病毒於哺乳動物細胞中有效複製相關;CDC表示目前尚未發現會影響抗病毒藥物及H5候選疫苗有效性之基因變化。 加拿大食品檢驗局(CFIA)於2月發布研究報告,去(2024)年10月於卑詩省8個禽場發現對奧司他韋(Tamiflu)具抗藥性之H5N1禽流感變異株,該變異株於NA蛋白帶有H275Y突變,該突變於2.3.4.4b分支中極為罕見;研究團隊表示病毒可能於去年9月底出現於該國,美國農業部(USDA)已將病毒指定為基因型D1.1。現有證據顯示突變可能降低病毒適應性,惟該病毒仍於15天內迅速傳播至8個禽場,研究團隊建議可能需重新評估流感治療策略。  年度摘要:  人類病例: 6例H5N1流感 (2003年迄今累計914例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽類/動物案例:累計44國家/地區通報907起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH 12/20針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要取決於接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測。
gYPIZchdh6adZRMNWcJmMQ.en: Weekly summary. Human cases: the USA and Cambodia each reported one new human H5N1 infection this week. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 15 countries reported 166 new H5N1 outbreaks between 9 November 2024 and 27 February 2025: the USA 93, Germany 15, the Netherlands 14, Poland 11, South Korea 9, Hungary 7, Czechia 6, Denmark 3, Belgium 2, and Mexico, Italy, Sweden, Cambodia, Bulgaria and Canada 1 each. Australia reported one new H7N8 outbreak on 22 February 2025. Peru reported 12 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 16 January and 13 February 2025. US dairy cattle avian influenza: dairy farms have reported 976 outbreaks cumulatively (3 new) in 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated in California, Nevada and Arizona. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 8,900 people monitored cumulatively, 217 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, with cat deaths. Wastewater surveillance: in week 8, 389 sampling sites reported results, with H5-positive detections at 10 sites in 4 states. Other updates: the US has updated information on three recent human H5N1 infections. A dairy farm worker in Nevada had only conjunctivitis and has recovered. A worker at an Ohio poultry farm had taken part in culling operations at an avian influenza farm, and a patient in Wyoming had been exposed to poultry that died at home. Both of the latter patients were hospitalized with serious illness and have since been discharged. Specimens from the Nevada and Wyoming patients were genotyped as clade 2.3.4.4b (genotype D1.1), a genotype that has spread widely among wild birds and poultry and was recently detected in dairy cattle in Nevada and Arizona. Both patients' specimens showed a mutation in the PB2 protein associated with efficient replication in mammalian cells. The CDC says it has not yet found genetic changes affecting the effectiveness of antivirals or H5 candidate vaccines. Canada's Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA) published a research report in February: in October last year, an H5N1 avian influenza variant resistant to oseltamivir (Tamiflu) was found on 8 poultry farms in British Columbia. The variant carries the H275Y mutation in the NA protein, which is very rare in clade 2.3.4.4b. The research team said the virus may have appeared in the country in late September last year. The USDA has designated the virus as genotype D1.1. Current evidence suggests the mutation may reduce viral fitness, yet the virus still spread rapidly to 8 poultry farms within 15 days. The research team recommends that influenza treatment strategies may need to be reassessed. Annual summary: 6 human H5N1 cases (914 cumulative since 2003), most with prior exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal cases: 44 countries and territories have reported 907 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 20 December. H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; human cases have generally involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk is low for the general public, and low to moderate for people who often handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the type and duration of exposure, protection and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

z7UFQ_w1WyP7B04paDqCjw.en: Texas, USA: the outbreak continues to expand. As of 25 February, 124 cases had been reported in 9 counties, of which 18 were hospitalized. Most patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Gaines County currently has the most cases, with 80. Lea County in neighbouring New Mexico has reported 9 cases cumulatively. Canada: southeastern Canada has more cases than usual. Ontario has reported 57 confirmed and 6 suspected cases cumulatively this year, and Quebec has reported 27 cases cumulatively since December last year. New Brunswick has had an outbreak since October last year, which has affected surrounding areas to date. Canada's annual case numbers over the past decade have ranged from 0 to 418; the historical high was 751 in 2011, and more than 70 cases had been reported cumulatively this year as of mid-February. England, UK: 91 confirmed cases have been reported this year, mainly in Yorkshire and the Humber and the South West. England reported over 2,900 cases in 2024, the highest since 2012. Large outbreaks occurred in Birmingham and London last year, with small clusters elsewhere. The outbreak has eased since July last year, although small-scale outbreaks continue in some areas. Scotland has reported 17 cases this year as of 19 February; it reported 1 case in 2023 and 24 in 2024.

io59-FSo_5POydfN0GDt7A.en: In Ontario, Canada, an outbreak occurred at the University of Guelph on 6 January. As of 10 January, 170 cases had been reported cumulatively. The school immediately restricted student activities and strengthened hygiene education.

dxO7vWafGaUdxOnyEtOGDg.en: In South-East Asia, Viet Nam's measles outbreak has surged this year: as of 21 December, nearly 5,000 cases had been reported cumulatively, more than a hundredfold increase over last year's total. Ho Chi Minh City accounts for the largest share, with 1,800 cases. The outbreak is still ongoing, and case numbers have recently been rising in northern provinces too. Authorities attribute this wave to the natural disease cycle and low vaccination coverage. In Cambodia, cases have also risen this year: as of 22 December, 375 cases had been reported cumulatively across 17 provinces, and authorities urge parents to make sure their children are vaccinated. In North America, Ontario, Canada, reported 63 cases cumulatively as of 18 December this year, sharply up from 7 cases last year; one patient died. Of these cases, 37 were linked to the measles cluster in New Brunswick Province, and most cases were unvaccinated. In Eastern Europe, Ukraine reported 333 cases cumulatively as of November this year, six times the same period last year. Cases have recently risen in the south-western Chernivtsi Oblast; authorities say the situation is under control but still urge children and pregnant women to be vaccinated. In North Africa, cases have risen recently in the Tangier-Tétouan-Al Hoceima region of northern Morocco. Chefchaouen and Tétouan provinces have reported 50 and 70 cases respectively, and at least three child deaths have occurred.

5Le7wF2JlCuYzShdrD6Bzg.en: Americas update: As of 25 November this year, 11,634 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 2 deaths, both from Brazil. Tz8N6ryupaUilUUT7EpaRw.en:
According to Africa CDC, across Africa as of 8 November this year, 20 countries have cumulatively reported 55,413 cases, including 12,162 confirmed cases and 1,142 deaths (CFR: 2.06%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo is the most severely affected, reporting 9,456 confirmed cases, followed by Burundi with 1,834 cases. Uganda, with 443 cases, has seen a marked rise in its outbreak, and the remaining countries reported between 1 and 118 cases each.

Manitoba Province, Canada, reported the country's first clade Ib case on 22 November. The patient had recently travelled to an African country with ongoing outbreaks, is in isolation, and contacts are being traced. Authorities assess the risk to the general public as still low.

Americas update: In Ontario, Canada, 1 death was newly reported in early October. The patient was a child who had had contact with bats. The proportion of bats carrying rabies in the area appears to be rising. Authorities urge anyone who has had contact with bats to seek medical treatment, regardless of whether there are wounds. In Tocantins State, Brazil, 1 new case was reported in late October; the exposure circumstances were not stated, and authorities have gone to investigate rabies-carrying animals.

Asia update: In Dong Nai and Quang Nam provinces, Viet Nam, 1 death each was newly reported in September and October respectively. Both patients had been bitten by dogs and were unvaccinated. The case fatality rate of rabies in Viet Nam once symptoms develop is 100%. In Davao del Norte Province, Philippines, 1 death was newly reported in late October; the patient had eaten dog meat, and authorities have begun tracing people with shared exposure.

OKDy02gZTBFfsOL1H38NGQ.en: British Columbia, Canada, announced on 13 November the first confirmed human H5N1 infection in the country. The patient is an adolescent, currently hospitalized in critical condition. Contact tracing and prophylactic treatment have been carried out, and no further cases have been found so far. The patient had no contact with birds or high-risk environments, and the source of infection remains unknown. The virus is genotype 2.3.4.4b (D1.1), related to locally circulating poultry viruses, and authorities have ruled out transmission from dairy cows or milk.

Ho Chi Minh City in southern Viet Nam continues to see rising outbreaks. Weekly new cases exceeded 140 in late October, and cumulative cases this year reached nearly 1,500 as of 7 November. About one quarter of cases were infants under 9 months old, who are not eligible for vaccination. Authorities have approved early vaccination with monovalent measles vaccine for children aged 6 months and older, and have expanded vaccination to staff at schools and social welfare institutions.

In New Brunswick, eastern Canada, outbreaks are rising, with 25 cases cumulatively reported since mid-October this year. Further potential cases are expected, and authorities urge people to strengthen protection and get vaccinated.
